source: ACGME Endocrinology, Diabetes and Metabolism Milestones 2.0

level_1: Elicits and reports the basic elements of an endocrine-specific history for common presentations
Performs and concisely reports an endocrine- specific physical exam for complex presentations
level_2: Performs and reports the basic elements of an endocrine-specific physical exam for common presentations
Efficiently elicits and concisely reports an endocrine-specific history for rare endocrine presentations
level_3: Elicits and concisely reports a thorough endocrine-specific history for common presentations
Performs and concisely reports an endocrine- specific exam for rare endocrine presentations
level_4: Performs and concisely reports an endocrine- specific physical exam for common presentations
Elicits and reports atypical history or physical exam findings which deviate from usual presentations of common, complex, and rare endocrine disorders
level_5: Efficiently elicits and concisely reports an endocrine-specific history for complex presentations

subcompetencies.name: Diagnostic Testing, including Labs, Imaging, and Dynamic Testing

level_1: Orders basic tests for patients with common endocrine conditions
Interprets targeted tests for patients with complex endocrine conditions, with assistance, and identifies incongruencies
level_2: Interprets basic endocrine test results
Develops individualized cost-effective testing strategies to evaluate patients with complex endocrine conditions and avoids unnecessary testing
level_3: Orders targeted tests for patients with common endocrine conditions using medical evidence
Independently interprets targeted tests for patients with complex endocrine conditions and resolves incongruencies
level_4: Independently interprets targeted tests for common endocrine conditions
Identifies, critically evaluates, and selectively uses emerging and investigational tests or procedures; questions and reports unknown and unexplained discrepancies
level_5: Orders targeted tests for patients with complex endocrine conditions

level_1: Prescribes basic endocrine therapeutics and describes their indications and adverse effects or reactions
level_2: Prescribes and monitors therapeutics used in patients with common endocrine conditions, based on patient factors
level_3: Prescribes and monitors the response to pharmacotherapy used in the management of patients with complex endocrine conditions
level_4: Integrates the best available evidence to prescribe, monitor, and assess the response to pharmacotherapy used in the management of patients with common, complex, and rare endocrine conditions
level_5: Identifies targeted or experimental therapies for complex and rare clinical scenarios

level_1: Observes and describes endocrine procedures
level_2: Performs procedures, with significant supervision
level_3: Performs more complex procedures, with moderate supervision
level_4: Independently performs procedures
level_5: Independently performs complex procedures

level_1: Respectfully receives consultation requests and responds with assistance
Recognizes disease acuity and prioritizes management steps
level_2: Recognizes disease acuity, with supervision
Effectively conveys consultative assessment, rationale, and contingency plans to all health care team members
level_3: Clearly and concisely provides consultation
Mobilizes resources to provide care in high- acuity situations
level_4: Independently recognizes disease acuity
Is identified as a role model for the provision of consultative care across the spectrum of disease complexity and acuity
level_5: Verifies understanding of recommendations with the primary team when providing consultation

level_1: Identifies the need to request a consultation
level_2: Clearly articulates the reason for requesting a consultation
level_3: Checks one’s own understanding of recommendations when receiving consultation
level_4: Coordinates recommendations from different consultants to optimize patient care
level_5: Facilitates conflict resolution between and among consultants when disagreement exists

subcompetencies.name: Integration of Pathophysiology and Clinical Reasoning

level_1: Demonstrates knowledge of pathophysiology of common endocrine conditions and develops a differential diagnosis
level_2: Applies knowledge of pathophysiology to explain common presentations and prioritizes the differential diagnoses and therapeutic options
level_3: Applies knowledge of pathophysiology to explain complex presentations and critically assesses diagnostic assumptions and therapeutic options
level_4: Integrates advanced knowledge of pathophysiology to recognize and explain the clinical presentations of and therapeutic options for a rare condition
level_5: Integrates knowledge of nuanced aspects of pathophysiology toward individualized diagnostic and therapeutic approaches, while challenging conventional ideas

level_1: Identifies areas worthy of scholarly investigation, with supervision
level_2: Designs a scholarly project, with supervision
level_3: Implements a scholarly project, with supervision
level_4: Produces scholarly work suitable for dissemination
level_5: Publishes original scholarly work that has generated new medical knowledge, enduring educational materials, or process improvement

level_1: Identifies and reports patient safety events using the institutional reporting system and discloses them to leadership, patients, and patients’ family members
Participates in quality improvement projects
level_2: Demonstrates basic knowledge of quality improvement methodologies and metrics
Participates in efforts to modify systems to prevent patient safety events
level_3: Analyzes the factors that contributed to a patient safety event
Demonstrates the skills required to identify, develop, implement, and analyze a quality improvement project
level_4: Identifies opportunities for quality improvement projects
Leads efforts to modify systems to prevent patient safety events
level_5: Offers prevention strategies to mitigate patient safety events
Leads quality improvement projects

level_1: Identifies the important elements of transitions and coordination of care
level_2: Safely and effectively transitions and coordinates care of patients in routine clinical situations
level_3: Effectively transitions and coordinates care of patients utilizing interprofessional teams in complex clinical situations
level_4: Role models effective coordination and transition of care
level_5: Leads in the design and implementation of improvements to the care coordination process

subcompetencies.name: Physician Role in Health Care Systems and Community Health

level_1: Identifies key components of the health care and payment systems; identifies health care needs in the community
Advocates for health policy changes
level_2: Describes how complex health care and payment systems impact patient care and contribute to health care barriers
level_3: Advocates within the health care system and payor to provide cost- effective, patient-centered care and reduce barriers
level_4: Advocates for adapting local practices to provide for the needs of specific populations and communities with health care needs
level_5: Adapts local practices to provide for the needs of specific populations and communities with health care needs

level_1: Articulates clinical questions to guide evidence-based care
level_2: Locates and applies the best available evidence, integrated with patient values and preferences, to the care of patients with common conditions
level_3: Locates and applies the best available evidence, integrated with patient values and preference, to the care of patients with complex and rare conditions
level_4: Critically appraises conflicting or ambiguous evidence to guide individualized patient care
level_5: Mentors others to critically appraise and apply evidence

subcompetencies.name: Reflective Practice and Commitment to Personal Growth

level_1: Demonstrates receptiveness to feedback
level_2: Modifies behavior based on feedback and establishes personal and professional goals based on gaps in knowledge and skills
level_3: Seeks feedback; creates and implements an individualized learning plan
level_4: Uses performance data to assess the effectiveness of the learning plan, and improves it when necessary
level_5: Role models consistently seeking performance data with adaptability, and mentors others on reflective practice

level_1: Demonstrates professional/ethical behavior in routine situations
level_2: Demonstrates a pattern of professional/ethical behavior in routine situations and takes responsibility when there are lapses
level_3: Demonstrates a pattern of professional/ethical behavior in complex or stressful situations
level_4: Recognizes situations that may cause professional/ethical lapses in others and intervenes to prevent lapses in oneself and others
level_5: Mentors others when their behavior fails to meet professional expectations

level_1: Performs tasks and responsibilities with prompting
level_2: Performs tasks and responsibilities in a timely manner with attention to detail in routine situations
level_3: Performs tasks and responsibilities in a timely manner with attention to detail in complex or stressful situations
level_4: Proactively implements strategies to ensure that the needs of patients, teams, and systems are met
level_5: Creates strategies to enhance others’ ability to efficiently complete tasks and responsibilities

level_1: Identifies elements of well-being
level_2: Describes resources that are meant to promote well-being
level_3: Recognizes status of well- being in oneself or peers and knows how to report concerns to appropriate personnel
level_4: Develops a plan to improve well-being of oneself or peers, including use of institutional or external resources
level_5: Creates institutional-level interventions that promote colleagues’ well-being

level_1: Uses clear language and non-verbal behavior to demonstrate respect and establish rapport
Adjusts communication strategies based on identified barriers, incorporating patient and caregiver expectations and goals of care
level_2: Recognizes common barriers to effective communication (e.g., language, disability)
Independently uses shared decision making to make a personalized care plan
level_3: Establishes a therapeutic relationship with patients using active listening and clear language in straightforward encounters
Proactively improves communication by addressing barriers and biases
level_4: Recognizes complex barriers to effective communication (e.g., health literacy)
Serves as a role model in establishing respectful, culturally sensitive, therapeutic relationships while mitigating communication barriers
level_5: Establishes a therapeutic relationship with patients’ and their families in challenging patient encounters

level_1: Uses language that is respectful and values all members of the health care team
level_2: Communicates basic information and provides feedback to all health care team members
level_3: Communicates complex information and provides difficult feedback to all health care team members
level_4: Optimizes communication strategies using input from all team members to build consensus and resolve conflicts as needed
level_5: Demonstrates leadership in promoting open and safe communication within and between teams

level_1: Verifies and accurately records current and relevant information in the patient's chart
Guides departmental or institutional documentation policy and procedures
level_2: Concisely documents diagnostic and therapeutic reasoning, accurately reflecting patient course for common conditions
level_3: Concisely documents diagnostic and therapeutic reasoning, accurately reflecting patient course for complex conditions
level_4: Concisely documents diagnostic and therapeutic reasoning, accurately reflecting patient course for all conditions while satisfying institutional billing needs and compliance
level_5: Mentors others in in documenting diagnostic and therapeutic reasoning, accurately reflecting patient course
